name: Kwame Silva
headline: Application Security Engineer
summary: Application Security Engineer focused on securing product features, reviewing code paths, and reducing risk across shipped services. Experienced in building practical controls with engineering teams, improving authentication flows, and turning findings into actionable fixes. Comfortable working across development and security operations in fast-moving environments.

roles.title: Application Security Engineer

Built Rust components for security checks around OAuth flows, reducing authentication defects caught late in testing by 35%.
Worked with engineers to trace risky code paths, document issues clearly, and close recurring gaps in the backend.

roles.title: Application Security Engineer
bullets: Secured AWS workloads by tightening IAM policies, improving OAuth handling, and validating exposed paths through Penetration testing.

Applied Cryptography practices to protect sensitive data, strengthened logging for incident review, and coordinated remediation with product teams.
